# AGENTS.md — 08-bakery

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Crumb & Co.**, home bakery, style "Hand-drawn pastel".
- Stack: Tailwind CSS 4, Alpine.js, Vite. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.js` — products, batches, notes, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/main.js` — Alpine component, doodles, countdown
- `index.html` — markup with Alpine directives
- `src/style.css` — tokens in Tailwind `@theme` + hand-drawn utilities

## How to run
- `npm install`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Chalkboard of today's bake with a live countdown to the next batch + allergen filters.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Ink is cocoa brown, never black. Pastels are paper colours, not gradients.
- Borders are hand-drawn: irregular radius + the #wobble SVG filter.
- Caveat for headings and prices, Nunito for reading text.
- Things may tilt (cards, notes), the grid may not.
- Doodles are single-stroke paths in main.js — add new ones in the same style.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
